item.title: Systems
item.description: Signals, materials, organisms, and computational structures are approached as interconnected environments rather than isolated mediums.

item.title: Process
item.description: Projects develop through experimentation, observation, iteration, and interaction.

item.title: Interference
item.description: Interference is approached as both phenomenon and method: overlaps between signal and noise, order and instability, control and disruption.

item.title: Emergence
item.description: Artistic experimentation functions as a speculative and open-ended form of research influenced by biology, physics, cybernetics, and media theory. The practice focuses on behaviors and structures that emerge through interaction between systems and exceed the properties of their individual components.

item.title: Environment
item.description: Installations, sound works, generative visuals, instruments, and mixed media environments are developed as responsive structures that unfold over time.
